title: feat(types, rest, metadata-protocol): a package-scoped refusal names its candidates on every /data write door
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu94uixEqeHjbNUUwi2GFYcE)_
domain:server#7 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXpSvRDJrG48CoU63g (card thread; taken over from domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbnEFPqp8kZfuAPeRv)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：写入钩子抛出"按名称指代不唯一"的拒绝（409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT）时，/data 的每个写入口都在回答里列出候选包 `details.candidates`，单条写在 body 上，批量写在每行的错误上。
- 为什么改：管理员给用户授一个两个包都带的权限集时，只看到"有歧义"，看不到该在哪几个包之间选；/actions、/meta 等门早就列出候选了。
- 风险与回滚：只新增一个字段，状态码、code、文案都不变；唯一冲突、版本冲突等其它 409 逐字节不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.ts` 的 `packageScopedRefusalCandidates` 与 resolver 的 `details`；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-client-failures.ts` 的 `toRowApiError`；`packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts` 的声明状态直通分支。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/data-package-scoped-refusal-candidates.test.ts`，26 例全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #32250
Refs #32622

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

A write hook's package-scoped refusal (core's `PackageScopedNameRefusedError`, `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`: the `sys_user_permission_set` grant hook throws it when two packages ship a permission set of the name typed) now names its holders on every `/data` write door, as `details.candidates`, in the shape `/actions`, `/automation`, `/meta` and the activation door answer (`[{ kind: 'package', packageId }, …]`, copied from the refusal). ADR-0150 D5: every ambiguous by-name answer names its candidates.

- **`@objectstack/types`**: `packageScopedRefusalCandidates(error)`, the one recogniser. It reads the shape (`code === 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'`, a `refusal` whose `status` is `'refused'`, and a list of `candidates`): this package cannot import core, and the class satisfies the shape, as does an error that crossed a second copy of core. `resolveThrownHttpError` puts the candidates in `details.candidates` (card step 1). `mapDataError`'s declared-status passthrough adds `details: { candidates }` after `object`.
- **`@objectstack/rest`**: the `/meta` reader from #32201 (`packageScopedRefusalCandidates` in `error-response.ts`) now asks the types recogniser instead of keeping its own. `createMany` and the cross-object `POST /batch` pass `{ packageScopedCandidates: true }` to `handleRouteError`.
- **`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`**: `toRowApiError` adds `details: { candidates }` to a batch row's error. This file joined the order's file surface by the seat's ruling (claim amendment 6817764528, F2 = A).

No `packages/spec` change: `ApiErrorSchema.details` and the contract `ApiError.details` are `z.unknown()`, and `details.candidates` is in no spec schema, as on `/meta` and `/actions`.

### Every answer that moves (FROM → TO), all Clause-② yes (widening)

Measured on the blocker head `ec39bd8e5` (step 0) and again on this head; the action row was found after merging `main` and measured there.

| Door | FROM | TO |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /data/:object`, `PATCH /data/:object/:id`, `DELETE /data/:object/:id` (rest `crud-routes`, `mapDataError`) | `409 {error, code: RESOURCE_CONFLICT, object}` | the same plus `details: { candidates }` |
| `POST /data/:object/createMany` (rest `handleRouteError`) | same | same plus `details: { candidates }` |
| `POST /batch` cross-object (rest `handleRouteError`) | NOT MEASURED: the harness has no transactional batch and answers `501`; a throw there leaves through the `createMany` exit | `details: { candidates }` on a whole-request refusal |
| `POST /data/:object/updateMany`, `deleteMany`, `/batch` with create, update, upsert or delete, atomic or not (`toRowApiError`) | `207`, `results[i].errors[0] = {code: RESOURCE_CONFLICT, message, httpStatus: 409}` | the same plus `details: { candidates }` |
| The dispatcher's `/data` on `@objectstack/hono` (`dispatch()` catch-all → `declaredEnvelopeForThrow`) | `409 {success: false, error: {code, message}}` | `error.details.candidates` added |
| The dispatcher's `GET /meta/:type/:name/layers` for a name two packages register (`errorFromThrown`) | `409 {success: false, error: {code, message, httpStatus}}` | `error.details.candidates` added. This covers one cell of #32622, the registry-holder refusal on the dispatcher, and no more. The stored-row `/layers` refusal (a plain `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` error with no `refusal`) stays with #32622's own PR. The REST `/layers` door does not refuse at all; that is #32624. Neither is touched here |
| The dispatcher's bare `GET /meta/action/:name/layers` and `/published` for a name several holders register (#32365, merged from `main`) | `409` with the refusal's text naming every holder, `error.details` absent (the item read already carried `details.candidates`) | `error.details.candidates` added, the same list as the item read's, `{ kind: 'platform' }` included. #32365's pin in `meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts` now asserts it on all three doors, and its comment that said these two doors carry text only is corrected |

Census of the other doors the resolver's `details` reaches. Each gains `details.candidates` for this refusal only. None is pinned beyond the resolver unit, per the ruling:

- `thrownAnswerOf` (`types/actions-door-answer.ts`): the runtime dispatcher's `errorFromThrown` (`http-dispatcher.ts`) and the `/actions` reader (`action-dispatch.ts`). A test pins `thrownAnswerOf` itself.
- `declaredEnvelopeForThrow` (`plugin-hono-server/adapter.ts`): `HonoHttpServer.wrap` for every direct-mount route, and the `@objectstack/hono` catch-all above.
- `runtime/endpoint-executor.ts`, `service-storage/storage-routes.ts`, `service-print/print-routes.ts`, `rest/package-routes.ts`.

Other doors that send `mapDataError`'s body whole also gain the member for this refusal: `form-routes` (public form submit), `record-page-routes`, `data-action-routes` (field projection) and `search-routes`. Callers that read only `code`, `message` or `status` move nothing: `import-runner`, `mcp-http-tools`, `record-currency-backfill`, the `nestedRefusalEnvelope` sites, the runtime packages domain and marketplace install.

Unchanged and pinned as CONTROLS: a unique violation's `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION`, both on the whole-request doors and as a row error; the stale-version `409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE`; and a `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` thrown with no refusal, both whole-request and per row.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/data-package-scoped-refusal-candidates.test.ts` (new): real `RestServer` routes, protocol, `ObjectQL` and `SqlDriver`. A hook throws (a) the class and (b) a plain error of its shape. 4 whole-request doors and 7 per-row doors for each, plus 4 CONTROL cases.
- `packages/types/src/thrown-http-error.test.ts` (new top-level describe): the resolver and recogniser for the class shape and the plain shape, through `thrownAnswerOf`, and 7 controls.
- `packages/types/src/data-error-classification.package-scoped-candidates.test.ts` (new, in the per-arm file pattern of `data-error-classification.*.test.ts`): `mapDataError`, with controls.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts` (new top-level describe): the dispatcher's `/layers` for a two-holder name answers 409 with both holders, plus a one-holder control. #32365's describe in the same file now also asserts `details.candidates` on the action `/layers` and `/published`.
- `packages/adapters/hono/src/hono.test.ts` (new top-level describe): the hono twin door, plus a control. The throw is the class's shape, because core is not a dependency of this package.

## Acceptance notes

- This PR built on #32306 (#32164) and merged it as it moved. #32164 adds `SecurityCatalogResolution.holders`. The grant hook maps those holders into `refusal.candidates`, which is what the doors read.
- One recogniser now serves `/meta` (#32201), `/data`, the resolver and the batch row. Before this PR, rest held a class-or-shape copy of its own.
- Taken over by `domain:server#7` (os-sales) from `domain:server#3` (os-bill) under the epic hand-over; the branch, the commits and every reading below up to `5e4c7ec180` are the previous card thread's, carried forward unchanged.

## Verification

Final head `41354c38a3`: `main` at `cbf6956fe` merged into `2abf1d1d95` (local merge `9460dd3c5`; its only conflict was `meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`, where both sides' new describes are kept), then the previous thread's `5e4c7ec180` merged in. That last merge changes no file: `git diff 9460dd3c5 41354c38a` is empty, so every reading taken on `9460dd3c5` is a reading of this head's tree. Every run went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` on a shared container. The lock excludes other locked runs only, so no wall-clock figure here is an idle-box reading.

<details><summary>On 41354c38a3 (tree of 9460dd3c5): closure build, five packages' typecheck and test, lint, 68 gates</summary>

- Build: `pnpm --filter` closure of types, rest, hono, runtime and metadata-protocol, lock VERDICT command-exit 0; later the full `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (119/119 tasks), lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `typecheck` for types, metadata-protocol, rest, runtime and hono: Done each.
- `test`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0:
  - `@objectstack/types`: 39 files, 881 passed.
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: 344 files (337 passed, 7 skipped); 22763 passed, 36 skipped.
  - `@objectstack/rest`: 407 files; 7972 passed, 332 skipped.
  - `@objectstack/runtime`: 585 files; 10084 passed, 19 skipped.
  - `@objectstack/hono`: 14 files, 236 passed.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 68 families from the merge base `cbf6956fe`; all 68 recorded `exit 0`. Two first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, nothing measured) and were re-run, not counted green from the first run: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` after fetching its pinned fixture commit into this shallow clone (48 cases pass), and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` after the full build (123 entry points across 72 packages load). `--ran` with the exit-coded record: 68 derived, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (a derived zero: every line carries an exit code, none is 3).
- Changed lines: 564 (+540 / -24) over 11 files, under 3000.
</details>

<details><summary>On 2abf1d1d95 and 5e4c7ec180: the previous card thread's readings, unchanged</summary>

On `2abf1d1d95` (`main` `6bbdf301` merged, after `turbo run build`), `vitest run` exit 0 each: types 40 files, 892 passed; rest 412 files, 8233 passed, 355 skipped; metadata-protocol 336 files, 22738 passed, 36 skipped; hono 14 files, 236 passed; plugin-hono-server 39 files, 513 passed; runtime three files (`meta-qualified-item-read`, `permission-set-package-doors`, `action-dispatch`), 117 passed; plugin-security three files (`grant-permission-set-package`, `granted-by-writer-provenance`, `grant-permission-set-name`), 75 passed. Dogfood (`@objectstack/dogfood`, the full battery): 454 files passed and 3 skipped; 3810 tests passed and 42 skipped; lock VERDICT command-exit 0.

On `5e4c7ec180` (`main` `5f84ef0eca` merged), exit 0 each: rebuild of the touched closures; the pins (types 14, rest 26, hono 72, runtime `meta-qualified-item-read` 47); metadata-protocol in full, 22763 passed, 36 skipped; `typecheck` for types, rest, metadata-protocol, hono and runtime; `pnpm lint`; 68 derived gates, `--ran` 68/68, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Roster gates rooted where this diff lives, on `2abf1d1d95`, exit 0 each: `check:authz-resolver`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, `check:route-ledger-census`.

**Ablations** (on `2abf1d1d95`). Each carry was reverted alone through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, with the marker checked in `dist` (`ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`), then restored to HEAD and the marker confirmed absent:

- A1, the resolver's `details.candidates`: the types resolver cases (3), the hono twin, and the runtime pins went red; in `meta-qualified-item-read` 3 failed: the `/layers` pin and both #32365 action-door cases.
- A2, `mapDataError`'s passthrough: the `mapDataError` pin and REST create, update and delete went red.
- A3, the `createMany` option: 2 cases went red.
- A4, `toRowApiError`: 14 per-row cases went red.

The source files these ablations mutate are byte-identical on this head (`git diff 2abf1d1d95 41354c38a3` touches none of them), so they were not repeated.
</details>

**Dogfood on this head:** not re-run. The title carries no `!` and Clause-② is the widening arm only, so the dispatch rules ask for no full battery; the previous thread's full battery on `2abf1d1d95` is above, and CI's `Dogfood Regression Gate` runs in the queue.

**Not measured:** the cross-object `POST /batch`. The harness has no transactional batch (see the door table).
